question: what uniform vertical raise of gen1 does routed sediment continuity demand, on the hillslopes only?

inputs.role: DEM of Difference, gen2 - gen1, m (+ = rose)
floodplain cells excluded from the hillslope budget (STANDING PROJECT RULE)
gen2 canopy cover fraction (PyForestScan), for the residual-structure table

params.name: z
params.why: the edge of 1 sigma, asked for 2026-08-26; mass_balance ships 1.96

params.name: channel_area_m2
params.why: catchment-dod-balance offmap default, as used in its own validation run

params.name: floodplain_mode
params.why: standing project rule: floodplain_mask cells out of hillslope mass balance

params.name: envelope
params.why: catchment-dod-balance README: independent is a documented LOWER BOUND

params.name: n_boot
params.why: block-bootstrap replicates for the SE; raise it if the SE is not stable

masks.name: floodplain
masks.defn: floodplain_mask.npy as shipped (TPI over an 800 m window < -2 m; analysis/ridgelines/convexity_dod_landcover.py)

masks.name: routed
masks.defn: D-infinity graph after breaching, floodplain cells REMOVED

masks.name: evaluable
masks.defn: routed & finite V_acc & not off-map-contaminated & N_up > 0

columns.f_flagged: fraction of evaluable cells still flagged as unphysical deposition (V_acc - V_in > z*sigma) after the raise, dimensionless
columns.keep: 1 - f_flagged; the balancing_offset 'keep' quantile that returns this delta
columns.delta_mm: uniform raise of gen1 (mm) = quantile(S, keep); = -1000 * balancing_offset(keep)['offset']
columns.se_mm: SE of delta_mm: SD over block-bootstrap replicates of the same quantile, blocks of side L (mm)
columns.net_vol_m3: sum over KNOWN evaluable cells of (dod - delta)*area, m^3; negative = the hillslope exports sediment
columns.L_m: side of the square spatial block resampled by the bootstrap, m
columns.n_blocks: number of blocks holding at least one evaluable cell
columns.band: drainage-area band of the evaluable cells, ha
columns.n: count of evaluable cells in the band
columns.median_S_mm: median over the band of S = the raise each cell demands, mm
columns.f0: fraction of the band flagged at delta = 0, dimensionless
columns.value: its value, units given in the name
columns.delta_api_mm: the same delta from catchment_dod_balance.balancing_offset, mm
columns.binding_cell: (row, col) of the cell that sets it
columns.cover: evaluable_fraction: share of the routed tile the datum rests on
columns.se_f0025_mm: SE of delta_mm at f_flagged = 0.025, mm
columns.se_f005_mm: SE of delta_mm at f_flagged = 0.05, mm
columns.se_f010_mm: SE of delta_mm at f_flagged = 0.10, mm
columns.val: its value, units in the name
columns.stratum: the cells the row is measured over
columns.f_res: fraction of them still flagged after the raise, dimensionless
columns.sill_sd_m: sqrt(partial sill) of that fit, m
columns.range_m: correlation length of that fit, m
columns.d_scene_mm: delta putting the scene net volume at +z sigma under that fit, mm
columns.mean_block_dod_mm: mean over blocks of the block-mean DoD, mm
columns.se_mean_mm: SE of that mean of block means = SD/sqrt(n_blocks), mm

headline: delta(f=0.05) = +31.2 mm on dod_cover_q2.npy, correlated envelope, floodplain routing
